tradeoff_justification_summary: Selected tau_class=0.95, tau_ret=0.52 (bounds unattainable on the development labels were relaxed to best achievable + 2%: {'max_hallucination_rate': 0.2535}; the most conservative thresholds within 1% of the best FCR): FCR 49.8%, escalation 50.2%, intent precision 98.4%, wrong-answer rate 24.9%, max parity gap 0.080 (not significant: True). Alternatives: tau_ret 0.57 -> FCR 46.8%, intent precision 98.3%, wrong-answer rate 25.2%; tau_ret 0.50 -> FCR 50.0%, intent precision 98.4%, wrong-answer rate 25.2%; tau_class 0.90 -> FCR 50.2%, intent precision 98.4%, wrong-answer rate 25.5%. The wrong-answer rate barely moves with the thresholds (label-noise floor), so the selection keeps auto-answers high while preferring stricter thresholds. Extra escalations cost Tier-1 time, but wrong automated answers reach paying customers unread.
